oracle_authority: Fixture recipes and generated expected file bytes are maintained separately from provider adapters. A provider report never defines its own expected output.

statuses.pass: Supported case, source identity exact, every expected output exact, no extra outputs, regions exact, byte accounting gap-free/non-overlapping, no unknown/unsupported/ambiguous bytes, explicit completeness claim truthful.
statuses.partial: No detected false output or source mismatch, but at least one byte is unexplained, unknown, ambiguous, unsupported, or the provider abstains from claiming completeness.
statuses.fail: Wrong source identity, missing/extra/wrong-content output, path collision, missed/false region, invalid range/accounting overlap, malformed path/hash, or complete-extraction claim that conceals unresolved bytes.
statuses.abstain: Provider explicitly declares unsupported/unknown capability and does not emit a purported result or claim completeness; abstention earns no extraction-recall credit.

metrics.known_file_recall_percent: 100 * exact expected path+logical ID+SHA-256+length matches / expected file count; empty expected set scores 100 only when no outputs are observed.
metrics.region_precision_recall: Exact expected region tuples (kind,start,end); unmatched expected or observed tuples count as misses/false positives.
metrics.accounted_unique_bytes: Union of valid in-bounds accounting spans, without double counting.
metrics.unexplained_bytes: Uncovered source bytes, including leading, internal and trailing gaps.
metrics.unresolved_bytes: Unknown + unsupported + ambiguous + unexplained + overlapping accounting byte count.
metrics.false_extraction_bytes: Bytes in wrong or extra extracted payload files; follow-up adapter should expose per-output bytes to compute the exact count.

caveats: Targets are proposed acceptance criteria, not achieved measurements.
Synthetic known-answer corpus must be reported separately from a held-out, authorized real-firmware corpus.
Provider-specific unsupported cases must be reported separately; they are neither passes nor misses in the supported-case denominator.
